text.en:
No. S 7

CORRIGENDUM INTERNATIONAL LIMITED PARfNERSHIP ORDER, 2600 (S 45/2000) In this Order, published in No. 28 of Part II of the Government Gazette, dated 20th. June, 2000, the following corrections are made(i) in section 14(31, the word "form" in the penultimate line of the paragraph should read as "from"; and

(ii) in section 20(4), in the second line immediately after "charge," the word "may" is deleted!.
